acquisition_method.evidence: inferred: The mass spectrometer was operated in the positive ion mode performing a survey MS (range 300 to 1800 m/z) and data-dependent MS/MS scans performed on the six most intense precursors with dynamic exclusion window of 40 s.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: The protein samples for phosphoproteomic analyses were diluted in lysis buffer and reduced with 10 mM DTT, alkylated with 20 mM IAA (both Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA), and digested with trypsin (Sequencing grade modified, Promega Corporation, Madison, WI, USA) overnight at an enzyme-to-substrate ratio of 1:60 (sequence grade modified trypsin).
